dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped motifs characterized by a high-contrast boundary of light-intensity pixels. These perimeters exhibit a steep gradient transition from the low-intensity dorsal background to the high-intensity ring, enclosing an interior of medium-to-low intensity pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of solid high-intensity pixels are visible at the tangential intersection points of the macro-annuli. These clusters lack internal gradients and are distributed with moderate density along the mid-dorsal and lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli in the upper-central region form a scalene triangle relative to the animal's longitudinal axis. A secondary group of four centroids in the posterior-dorsal region forms an irregular quadrilateral spatial relationship.
